children: Sunshine Silver expanded its Silver Valley mineral rights to ~38,000 acres and launched a multi-year, 45,000-meter surface exploration drilling program.
Expanded mineral rights by ~14,100 acres, a 60% increase to approximately 38,000 acres in Idaho's Silver Valley.
Initiated a district-scale, multi-year surface drilling program totaling ~45,000 meters to test expanded land targets.
Initial drill targets: East Sunshine (near the Sunshine Mine), Rock Creek and Pine Creek—drilling expected to start Q4 2026.
2025 reconnaissance (322 man-days, 128 rock samples, 2,935 soil samples) identified multiple drill-ready targets.
Company expects additional downshaft drill results from the Sunshine Mine’s infill program in Q4 2026.
